version.changelog:
- Updated dependencies in package.json for improved stability and compatibility.
- No user-facing changes or feature updates in this release.

llm.summary: The skill claims to only need a Neta API token to generate images, but the package/README/SKILL.md disagree with the registry metadata and the script attempts to read user .env files (potentially exposing unrelated secrets) and contains malformed/undefined code — this mismatch and scope creep are suspicious.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose (generate images via the Neta API) matches the presence of a NETA_TOKEN in README/SKILL.md and package.json. However the registry metadata lists no required env vars while package.json and runtime docs require NETA_TOKEN — an inconsistency that reduces trust. Requesting a Neta token is itself proportional to the declared purpose, but the metadata mismatch is unexplained.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs simply to run node furryart.js with a NETA_TOKEN. The included furryart.js, however, attempts to read other environment files from ~/.openclaw/workspace/.env and ~/developer/clawhouse/.env (via readEnvFile), which would access unrelated local configuration. The code is also malformed/partial (undefined functions/variables like readEnvFile, API_BASE, HEADERS, body, width, height and a stray block assigning body.inherit_params), indicating sloppy or tampered code. The extra .env reads are scope creep and could expose unrelated secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no download/install spec; this is instruction-only with a bundled script. No external downloads or extract/install steps appear in the package, lowering installation risk. The skill doesn't install additional binaries.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Package.json and SKILL.md require NETA_TOKEN (appropriate for a Neta API integration), but the registry metadata lists none — inconsistent. More importantly, the script tries to read other local .env files in the user's home which may contain unrelated credentials; that behavior is not justified by the stated purpose and is disproportionate to a simple image-generation task.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and has default autonomous invocation settings. It does not request persistent system presence or attempt to modify other skills or global agent config.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Do not install or run this skill until the inconsistencies are resolved. Specifically: (1) confirm the registry metadata is updated to declare NETA_TOKEN as required (or explain why it was omitted); (2) inspect and fix the furryart.js source — it contains undefined functions/variables and malformed blocks that could indicate tampering or an incomplete release; (3) remove any logic that attempts to read arbitrary user .env files (e.g., ~/.openclaw/workspace/.env or ~/developer/clawhouse/.env) — a generator should only use the explicit NETA_TOKEN passed via env or flag; (4) if you must test, run it in an isolated sandbox or VM and do not expose other secrets. If you can't verify these fixes, treat the skill as untrusted.
